data.narrative: Completed Module 3 learning reproduction science - chose synthetic reproduction strategy, created minimal 20-line script to reproduce race condition with 10 concurrent requests, fixed with PostgreSQL upsert (INSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE), diagnosed and fixed silent timestamp corruption using GREATEST() function to prevent lost updates.

dimension_scores.observation: Formed hypothesis that concurrency was the trigger variable (not data or timing) and tested by changing exactly one variable - sending 10 simultaneous requests instead of one at a time.
dimension_scores.evidence: module3_verification.md explains concurrency as trigger variable and why data/timing were ruled out

dimension_scores.observation: Used Module 02 logs with precise timestamps to compare actual request time vs database last_accessed_at timestamp, identifying the silent data corruption.
dimension_scores.evidence: module3_timestamp_corruption.md mentions using Module 02 logs to compare timestamps

dimension_scores.observation: Created minimal reproduction script that changes exactly one variable (concurrency), no authentication headers or retry logic. Script reliably reproduces 500 errors under concurrent load.

strengths: Created minimal reproduction script changing exactly one variable (concurrency)
Identified that almost all flaky bugs are actually deterministic with a trigger you haven't found
Fixed race condition with atomic upsert eliminating check-then-act pattern
Diagnosed silent data corruption by comparing log timestamps to database timestamps
data.recommendation: Continue to Module 04 to develop root cause depth skills - tracing past immediate triggers to systemic causes and asking 'why did this failure mode exist?'

public_evidence.artifact: Race condition reproduction script and fix
public_evidence.student_action: Created minimal 20-line Python reproduction script with 10 concurrent requests to trigger race condition, fixed with PostgreSQL upsert (INSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE) eliminating check-then-act pattern, verified zero 500 errors across 10 runs
public_evidence.technical_detail: Reproduction script uses asyncio and aiohttp to send 10 simultaneous requests to same short code. Fix uses SQL upsert: INSERT INTO analytics ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET count = count + 1
public_evidence.ability: Reproduction science and fixing race conditions with atomic database operations
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates ability to turn intermittent bugs into reliable reproduction, understand concurrency issues, and implement atomic database operations to prevent race conditions
